title: Core: motion tween easing
description: The getTweenedFrame function in packages/core/src/engine/tween.ts (or similar) currently interpolates motion tweens linearly (t=0..1). Implement Flash 8 easing: when frame.motionEase !== 0, apply the ease curve. Flash 8 ease: ease > 0 = ease-out, ease < 0 = ease-in. The formula: if ease > 0, t = 1 - (1-t)^(1 + ease/100 * 3); if ease < 0, t = t^(1 - ease/100 * 3). Find where linear interpolation happens and add easing. Add unit tests.
